label: Rank
help: How worth a detour it is: Amazing (go out of your way), Nice (worth a stop if you're near), Okay (a footnote, for completists).

label: Heritage status
help: Official listing: rijksmonument (national) and/or gemeentelijk monument (municipal).

label: Listed in
help: Year it was designated a monument.

label: Artist
help: Who made the mural or artwork.

label: Status
help: Set when the thing no longer exists; the pin marks where it was.

label: Needs checking
help: Something here is unconfirmed: the pin (Location), whether it still exists (Still there?), or a fact sources disagree on (Facts). Clear it once checked.

label: What to check
help: One line on what is unsure, e.g. "OSM puts the bench 120 m east of this pin."

label: Outlook
help: Known or likely to change or disappear. Set it so the place can be followed up; clear it once the change has happened (then update the place or mark it Gone).

label: Expected
help: When, as far as known, e.g. "early 2028" or "Nov 2026 to Mar 2027".

label: What is changing
help: One line: what is planned or feared, and by whom.
